notice: Every value in this file is an assumption chosen for a teaching simulation. Nothing here is a measurement of the GuitarAlchemist ecosystem, and no result computed from it is a forecast.

approach.model: x[t+1] = x[t] + step * (x[t]^2 - q[t]^2) + noise_sd * e[t], e standard normal; fold at q = 0
approach.q_schedule: linear in t from q_start at t = 0 to q_end at t = n - 1, so the resting level -q[t] moves in a straight line
approach.tipped_when: x[t] > q[t], the state has passed the unstable point

alarm_rules.statistic: M = min(Kendall tau of the rolling variance against time, Kendall tau of the rolling lag-1 autocorrelation against time)

naive_test.tau_standard_deviation_if_values_were_in: sqrt(2 * (2 * m + 5) / (9 * m * (m - 1))) for m rolling values

kendall.label: six consecutive rolling values, invented for a hand computation

window.label: one four-point window, invented for a hand computation

constant_windows.label: invented series with one step, to test the count of constant windows

tipping_positive_control.purpose: the main batches are expected to contain no tipped run; this batch has four times the noise so the tipping detector has something to find

transfer_task.notice: Hypothetical inputs for the learner task. They are not results of the simulation above and not measurements of any project.
